criteria.statement: Classify managed instance health and persist newest material transitions.
Respect operator intent, maintenance, budget, backoff, idempotency, and apply-lock contention.
Project sanitized canonical 30315, 30900, and 4903 observables from subscriptions.
Default to disabled observe-only-safe configuration and validate enabled configuration.
Expose bounded, sanitized, tenant-scoped health and history reads plus authenticated maintenance changes.
Present managed instance status, resource, recovery, event, and maintenance state in the operator UI.
Classify disposable Docker failures, restart only the exact target, and suppress restart during maintenance.
